rachel: Starting thread for profile_props staggered backfill + schema flip tonight. proposed window: 2026-03-26 01:30 UTC. request lock window 01:25-01:40 to allow a short safety rollback.

mike: prefer 15m total quiesce: canary 01:30-01:33 on shard A, then 01:34-01:40 rollout to remaining shards. keep backfill throttle low (30r/s) for hot partitions.

rachel: agreed. pin consumers to app=2.4.2-dbpatch-20260326 for 6h post-migration. will gate schema flip with feature flag `profile_props_v2`.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: profile_props.backfill_v2 -> 2026-03-26T01:30:00Z
 - canary: shard-A 01:30-01:33
 - rollout: 01:34-01:40
 - version_pin: app=2.4.2-dbpatch-20260326
 - rollback_cmd: `deploybot abort 1869998888`
 - preflight: tests + checksum required

ops: backup snapshot taken at 01:10 UTC (snap-id snap-20260326-0110). binary checksum matches.

sasha: note: partition key country=IN shows high write QPS; recommend paged backfill there. also add metric to watch: db.lock_wait_p95 and app.write_errors.

ci-bot: PRE-RUN CHECKLIST:
 - snapshot present: yes
 - preflight smoke: OK
 - monitoring dash pinned: profile_props-backfill
 - rollback hook: enabled
To abort: `deploybot abort 1869998888`

mike: abort criteria proposal: if lock wait > 3s for >2 DB nodes OR write error rate >0.7% for 3 consecutive minutes -> abort. on abort we will unpin consumers and flip feature flag off. escape hatch: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/svc-profile --to-revision=previous`

rachel: I'll post a 10m pre-warning to #prod-alerts and update release_notes: "profile_props: add preferences.flattened (nullable). Rolling backfills; consumers pinned to 2.4.2 for 6h."

sasha: after rollout, keep backfill lag <120s for 10m before flipping feature flag. if lag spikes, requeue paged backfill for that shard.

mike: I'm oncall. i'll monitor p95/p99, lock watch, and the backfill queue. ping @here when canary starts.

rachel: thanks — setting holdpoint in deploybot and updating runbook. see you in the window. :thumbsup:
